name: West Street and the Stahl Theatre

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Stahl Theatre on West Street was a Congregational chapel. Oundle School bought it in the late 1970s and opened it as a theatre in 1980.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:West Street is one of Oundle's old streets, lined with stone houses and inns.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:On West Street you meet Josiah Gant, landlord of a rival inn. He is very keen to tell you where he was last night.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Josiah's story]]
material: [[c:JOSIAH: "I was behind my own bar from dusk till dawn. Ask anyone."]]
[[c:POTBOY: "Master Gant sent me to bed at ten and locked up himself."]]
[[c:WATCHMAN: "I saw Master Gant near the Talbot yard after midnight, with a handcart."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Whose story can't be true? (name)]]
hints: [[c:Who says he never left his inn?]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Josiah says he was behind his bar all night, but the watchman saw him by the Talbot yard after midnight with a handcart.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:The watchman saw Josiah Gant near the Talbot yard after midnight with a handcart.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head west, about 150 metres as the crow flies, to the Jesus Church.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
